description.value: The Mission Visitor Centre is a tourism information office operated by Tourism Mission on the Lougheed Highway, serving as a gateway resource for visitors to the Mission area. Located along a major through-route in the Fraser Valley, it would be a natural stop for touring cyclists seeking local route information and area orientation. The operator Tourism Mission is distinct from the City of Mission municipal government.
